findings.label: Pre-click YouTube thumbnail request
findings.detail: toMediaSummary lets any https thumbnailUrl through, and YouTubeFacade/FeaturedContent render it before the click, so an admin-pasted i.ytimg.com thumbnail would contact YouTube before play. That contradicts plan decision 12 and the privacy text. Reject ytimg.com/youtube.com/youtube-nocookie.com/ggpht.com hosts in the mapper, or note the restriction in the admin hint.

findings.label: Media anchor missing for featured photos
findings.detail: Home featured cards link to /media#media-<id>, but gallery photos render without that id, so a featured IMAGE item scrolls nowhere. Add id="media-<id>" to the gallery thumbnail <li>, or link featured photos to their gallery group.

findings.label: Privacy note missing on Worship videos
findings.detail: The 'nothing loads until you press play' note appears under Sermons and Videos but not Worship, which also holds video embeds. Add the note to the Worship section.

findings.label: Screenshot capture artifacts
findings.detail: In media-en-375.png the lazy gallery thumbnails are blank, and in media-video-loaded-en-1280.png the sticky header is drawn mid-page. Scroll before capture (or use eager loading in the screenshot spec).
